knowledge_graph.merchant_description: "Conveniently located in Oakville at Trafalgar Rd & McCraney St E with free parking available. We offer adult & children's physiotherapy, massage therapy, pilates, custom bracing & orthotics. Our services are cost-effective with direct billing available. Ask us about a free no obligation consultation. We pride ourselves in offering the best care possible in a welcoming and supportive space; providing services in a variety of languages including English, German, Arabic & Polish. Whether you're suffering from pain, want to improve your health and overall fitness or are recovering from illness or an accident, we're here to help with physiotherapists & massage therapists."

posts.description: Is that stubborn knot in your back bothering you? If long hours at your desk leave you with shoulder blade tension, you're not alone. Explore some helpful tips to ease the discomfort and make your day a bit more comfortable.

Summer is here, and the fairways are calling! 🌞🏌️‍♂️ After a long winter, it's time to hit the driving range for some practice swings. Get ready to book those tee-times quickly and follow these tips to ace your game on the course! ⛳️

Summer fun can be tricky for those with vestibular disorders – uneven surfaces, travel, and visual stimulation often trigger symptoms. 
With the right strategies, you can still enjoy the season! Read on below.

Summer is here, which for most means spending more time outside under the sun. As much as we love outdoor activities, they pose some risk of injury due to factors like footwear, body mechanics, and the outdoor environment itself. 
The good news is that appropriate early care of injuries can optimize the recovery process and get you back to doing what you love with confidence. Here are five commonly seen injuries during the summertime, as well as the recommended approach to caring for them.

Using a stationary bike has many health benefits as it provides a solid workout, helping you to improve your heart health and strengthen your core and leg muscles. This is just one of the many reasons why millions of us continue to choose the humble bicycle. 
So, how do you avoid injuries? Here are a few tips to help you prevent injuries to your knees, neck, and back.

Do you have hip pain? Discover why and how to find relief! From sitting postures to activity levels, learn key tips to ease discomfort and improve your hip health. Get moving with confidence and comfort—click below for all the details!

Dealing with foot or heel pain? It could be plantar fasciitis. Try these simple exercises that may help manage pain and support recovery – whether it’s after long walks, sports, or standing all day. Try these exercises!
What is shockwave therapy? You’ve probably heard of it—but what exactly is shockwave therapy, and why are so many people talking about it? Discover how it may support your recovery journey.

Dealing with carpal tunnel syndrome? Tingling, numbness, or wrist pain can affect your work, hobbies—even walking your dog. Whether you’re at a desk, on a job site, or on your phone, here are 6 simple exercises that may help manage symptoms.
